content_of_post_to_comment: Look, I've got a lot of problems with Theism. I think the Problem of Suffering/Problem of Non-Human Animal Suffering is a real issue for Theism. I think there are several great reasons to disbelieve in it. But I just don't see the logical problems with the Trinity as compelling reason to disbelieve, in the slightest. More than that, maybe it's a bit of conceptual naivety, but it seems pretty solvable via Frege’s sense-reference distinction.
